channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact prize - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• SIAP: Major Individual Artists Award 2026/27 (Arts Council NI)
    https://artscouncil-ni.org/funding-for-individuals/major-individual-artists
    Arts Council of Northern Ireland · deadline Closed 20 Jul 2026 · Up to GBP 15,000 per award; four awards available in 2026/27. Funded through the National Lottery Support for Individual Artists Programme (SIAP).

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact prizes - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• PLAYA Art/Sci Awarded Residency 2027
    https://playasummerlake.org/2027-artsci/
    PLAYA · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Awarded residency providing free lodging in a private cabin with kitchen and bathroom plus one weekly group meal. Residents cover their own travel, groceries, and materials. No cash stipend. USD 40 application fee (waivers granted on request by June 28, 2026)
  • Manuel António da Mota Prize – 17th Edition (2026)
    https://www.fmam.pt/edicao-em-curso-introducao/
    Fundação Manuel António da Mota (FMAM) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Total prize fund. The winning application receives a cash prize of EUR 50,000. Second and third place receive EUR 25,000 and EUR 10,000 respectively. The remaining 7 applications (honourable mentions) each receive a cash prize of EUR 5,000.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact prizes - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Jamverse Jam (Protocolized worldbuilding contest)
    https://protocolized.summerofprotocols.com/p/jamverse-jam
    Protocolized (Summer of Protocols) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · One USD 1,000 grand prize plus at least 10 additional USD 200 prizes; winning artifacts are published on the Jamverse website. No entry fee.
  • Fulbright-Iméra Mediterranean Studies Award 2027-2028 (Aix-Marseille, US Faculty)
    https://fulbrightscholars.org/award/fulbright-imera-mediterranean-studies-award-aix-marseille-university
    Iméra – Aix Marseille Université, in partnership with the Fulbright Commission · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · €2,400 (~USD 2,600) monthly stipend; fully covered accommodation (valued USD 788–1,966/month); €1,200 (~USD 1,300) travel allowance. No application fee.
